jobs.description:
*En fonction du poste, Bombardier offre des politiques de travail flexibles et hybrides.*

#### **Pourquoi vous joindre à nous?**

  

Chez Bombardier, nous concevons, construisons, modifions et entretenons les avions les plus performants du monde pour les individus, les entreprises, les gouvernements et les entités militaires les plus avisés. Nous réussissons à établir les normes les plus élevées grâce à notre approche centrée sur les personnes, et toujours en définissant l'excellence, ensemble.  

  

Travailler chez Bombardier signifie offrir ce qu’il se fait de mieux. Chaque jour, vous faites partie d’une équipe qui offre des expériences et des produits de qualité supérieure, repoussant les limites du possible dans notre industrie et au\-delà. En priorisant la croissance et le développement des employées, nous permettons à chacune d'atteindre son plein potentiel à sa manière, parce que le meilleur travail se produit lorsque vous êtes libre d'être vous\-même et de partager votre expertise unique.

#### **Nos avantages sociaux**

  



En veillant au bien\-être de nos employés, nous proposons un programme d'avantages sociaux complet et compétitif, qui comprend les éléments suivants :

* Régimes d'assurance *(Soins dentaires, soins médicaux, assurance\-vie, assurance\-invalidité, et plus encore)*
* Salaire de base compétitif
* Régime d'épargne retraite
* Programme d'aide aux employés
* Programme de télésanté

### **Quelles sont vos contributions envers l’équipe?**

* Concevoir, développer, tester, déployer et soutenir des applications et des API sécurisées, de la preuve de concept à la mise en production.
* Développer des interfaces utilisateur réactives et accessibles, ainsi que des services dorsaux robustes et fiables.
* Intégrer les solutions aux systèmes d’entreprise existants et aux plateformes approuvées, notamment Azure, Databricks, SAP S/4HANA, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Power BI ainsi que les API ou services connexes.
* Transformer des modèles de prévision, d’optimisation, de traitement du langage naturel, de génération augmentée par récupération (RAG) et de classification en solutions exploitables au moyen d’interfaces et de flux de travail fiables.
* Mettre en œuvre les contrôles requis pour l’identité, les autorisations, la gestion des secrets, le chiffrement, la validation des entrées, la journalisation d’audit, les sauvegardes et la reprise.
* Mettre en place des pipelines de livraison automatisés, des pratiques d’Infrastructure as Code (IaC), des essais automatisés, des analyses de vulnérabilités et des processus de gestion des mises en production.
* Assurer la surveillance des applications et de l’infrastructure, la réponse aux incidents, l’optimisation de la performance et la planification de la maintenance.
* Collaborer avec des parties prenantes interfonctionnelles des secteurs affaires, technologies, données, gouvernance et livraison, à l’échelle de l’entreprise.
* Traduire les besoins d’affaires en conceptions techniques maintenables et en critères d’acceptation clairs.
* Recueillir les données d’utilisation et la rétroaction des utilisateurs afin d’améliorer l’adoption, l’accessibilité et la performance des produits.
* Tenir à jour la documentation liée à l’architecture, aux opérations, à la sécurité et au soutien.
### **Comment vous épanouir dans ce rôle?**

* Vous détenez un baccalauréat en informatique ou dans un domaine connexe.
* Vous comptez au moins trois ans d’expérience en développement logiciel infonuagique.
* Vous maîtrisez TypeScript/JavaScript et Python.
* Vous avez de l’expérience avec React ou avec un autre cadre frontal moderne équivalent.
* Vous avez une expérience pratique du développement sur Azure, notamment avec App Service, Azure Functions, les conteneurs, le stockage, les files d’attente, l’identité et la surveillance.
* Vous avez de l’expérience dans l’intégration d’applications avec Databricks, notamment SQL, les notebooks ou les tâches, les points de terminaison de service de modèles, les modèles Lakehouse et les concepts d’Unity Catalog.
* Vous avez de l’expérience en intégration d’entreprise avec des systèmes d’affaires existants, SAP S/4HANA, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Power BI, des API ou des intégrations événementielles.
* Vous connaissez bien les pratiques de sécurité des applications d’entreprise, notamment l’authentification, l’autorisation, la configuration sécurisée, la protection des données, les contrôles de validation et la journalisation d’audit.
* Vous faites preuve de solides aptitudes en collaboration et en communication.
* Vous maîtrisez le français et l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, et pouvez travailler efficacement dans un environnement bilingue.
#### **Maintenant que vous vous projetez dans ce rôle, postulez et rejoignez l'équipe Bombardier!**

  

Veuillez noter: Vous n'avez pas besoin de *toutes* les compétences, connaissances et expériences requises pour postuler à ce poste ! Nous ne sommes pas à la recherche du candidat·e parfait·e, mais d'une personne talentueuse et passionnée .

Analyste en assurance qualité (QA)
jobs.description:
Nous recherchons un Analyste en assurance qualité (QA) qui agira comme référent auprès de l’équipe de développement afin de structurer et de faire évoluer les pratiques de tests.  

  

Dans ce rôle, vous accompagnerez les développeurs, qui réalisent actuellement les tests, dans la mise en place de processus rigoureux et de meilleures pratiques en matière de tests manuels. Vous agirez comme partenaire et coach afin de les guider dans la conception, la structuration et l’amélioration de leurs scénarios de test.  

  

Dans un second temps, vous piloterez une transition progressive vers l’automatisation des tests en adoptant une approche pragmatique. L’objectif sera d’identifier les possibilités d’automatisation offrant la plus grande valeur ajoutée pour l’équipe et le produit.

**Fonctions et responsabilités**


Agir comme référent QA auprès de l’équipe de développement.  

Accompagner et conseiller les développeurs dans l’application des bonnes pratiques de tests.  

Structurer et améliorer les processus de tests manuels existants.  

Accompagner les développeurs dans la création, la révision et l’optimisation des scénarios et cas de test.  

Challenger de manière constructive la couverture, la pertinence et la qualité des tests.  

Assurer une gestion structurée des anomalies et contribuer à l’amélioration de leur suivi.  

Promouvoir des pratiques QA rigoureuses et adaptées à un environnement Agile.  

Optimiser l’utilisation d’Azure DevOps et d’Azure Test Plans dans le cadre des activités de tests.  

Identifier les scénarios pour lesquels l’automatisation présente une réelle valeur ajoutée.  

Piloter progressivement la transition vers une approche d’automatisation des tests intelligente et pragmatique.

**Qualités requises pour réussir dans ce rôle**


Exigences  

  

Minimum de 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en assurance qualité (QA).  

Expérience démontrée dans l’accompagnement, le coaching ou le mentorat d’équipes de développement.  

Excellente connaissance des processus et méthodologies de tests logiciels.  

Bonne maîtrise des pratiques ISTQB ou d’une méthodologie équivalente.  

Solide connaissance de la gestion et du suivi des anomalies.  

Expérience de travail dans un environnement Agile.  

Maîtrise avancée de la suite Azure DevOps, particulièrement Azure Test Plans.  

Capacité à structurer et à challenger des scénarios de tests manuels.  

Capacité à identifier les possibilités d’automatisation en fonction de leur valeur ajoutée.  

  

Atouts  

Certification ISTQB.  

Expérience dans la mise en place ou l’évolution d’une stratégie d’automatisation des tests.  

Connaissance d’outils ou de frameworks d’automatisation des tests.  

  

Profil recherché  

  

Vous adoptez une véritable posture de coach et de facilitateur. Vous faites preuve de patience et de pédagogie et êtes capable de transmettre les bonnes pratiques QA à des profils techniques. Votre approche collaborative vous permet de challenger les pratiques existantes de manière constructive tout en favorisant l’autonomie et l’amélioration continue de l’équipe.  

  

CGI offre une estimation raisonnable de la fourchette salariale pour ce poste. Le calcul de cette fourchette dépend de divers facteurs, notamment le niveau de compétence, le marché géographique, l’expérience, la formation ainsi que les licences et certifications professionnelles. Les décisions en matière de rémunération dépendent des particularités de chaque cas. Une estimation raisonnable de cette fourchette salariale se situe entre 65000$\-105000$. Ce poste est vacant.

**Ensemble, en tant que propriétaires, mettons notre savoir\-faire à l’œuvre.**  

  

La vie chez CGI est ancrée dans l’actionnariat, le travail d’équipe, le respect et un sentiment d’appartenance. Chez nous, vous pourrez exploiter votre plein potentiel parce que…
  

  

Nous vous invitons à devenir propriétaire dès le jour 1 alors que nous travaillons ensemble à faire de notre rêve une réalité. C’est pourquoi nous nous désignons comme associés de CGI, plutôt que comme employés. Nous tirons profit des retombées de notre succès collectif et contribuons activement à l’orientation et à la stratégie de notre entreprise.  

  

Votre travail crée de la valeur. Vous élaborerez des solutions novatrices et développerez des relations durables avec vos collègues et clients, tout en ayant accès à des capacités mondiales pour concrétiser vos idées, saisir de nouvelles opportunités, et bénéficier d’une expertise sectorielle et technologique de pointe.
  

  

Vous ferez évoluer votre carrière en vous joignant à une entreprise bâtie pour croître et durer. Vous serez soutenus par des leaders qui ont votre santé et bien\-être à cœur et qui vous permettront de saisir des occasions afin de parfaire vos compétences et élargir les horizons.  

  

Chez CGI, nous valorisons la richesse que la diversité apporte et nous nous engageons à favoriser un environnement de travail où chacun s’épanouit. Nous collaborons avec nos clients pour bâtir des communautés plus inclusives et permettre à tous les associés de CGI de réussir. En tant qu’employeur prônant l’égalité des chances, il est important pour nous que vous puissiez donner le meilleur de vous\-même durant le processus de recrutement. Si vous avez besoin d’un accommodement particulier, veuillez en informer votre recruteur.  

  

Ce même engagement envers l’équité s’étend à notre utilisation des technologies. Toutes les décisions d’embauche demeurent entièrement entre les mains de nos professionnels du recrutement.

jobs.description:
MDA Space (TSX : MDA) est un partenaire de mission de confiance de l’industrie spatiale mondiale qui crée l’espace entre ce qui est prouvé et ce qui est possible. À titre de pionnier de la robotique, des systèmes satellitaires et du renseignement géospatial, avec une histoire de 55 ans de premières mondiales et de plus de 450 missions, MDA Space est un chef de file mondial dans les domaines des satellites de communication, de l’observation de la Terre et de l’espace, ainsi que de l’infrastructure et l’exploration spatiale. L’équipe de MDA Space, qui compte plus de 5 500 experts de l’espace au Canada, aux États\-Unis et au Royaume\-Uni, possède les connaissances et le savoir\-faire nécessaires pour transformer la vision audacieuse du client en une mission réalisable, grâce à une combinaison unique d’expérience, d’excellence technique et d’émerveillement qui fait partie de notre ADN depuis le premier jour. Pour ceux qui rêvent grand et repoussent les limites sur terre et dans les étoiles afin de changer le monde pour le meilleur, nous vous y emmènerons.



Rejoignez notre équipe à Montréal en tant que Développeur\- Systèmes d'affaires pour usine connectée au sein de notre division de Systèmes Satellitaires et participez à des projets innovants qui repoussent les limites de la technologie spatiale!


***Il s'agit d'un mandat de 12 mois, renouvelable ou permanent*****.**


**Rôle :**



Sous la responsabilité du département Excellence opérationnelle, le développeur de systèmes d'entreprise est chargé de développer de nouvelles fonctionnalités et d'assurer le support des systèmes d'entreprise personnalisés existants, principalement liés à la fabrication, à la chaîne d'approvisionnement et à la qualité.



Le candidat est chargé de concevoir et de développer des fonctionnalités sur la base des exigences techniques fournies par l'équipe d'analystes commerciaux, ainsi que de déboguer les problèmes liés aux systèmes existants.



Le candidat doit posséder d'excellentes compétences en matière d'interprétation, de programmation, de communication et d'organisation. Il doit être capable de travailler de manière autonome, en faisant preuve d'initiative et avec peu de supervision.



Il doit faire preuve de dévouement pour respecter les délais des projets, en trouvant le juste équilibre entre la nécessité de fournir des résultats de qualité dans le respect du budget et du calendrier. Des compétences en matière de travail d'équipe et une attitude positive sont essentielles pour établir des relations de travail productives.


**Tâches :**


* Conception et développement : concevoir, développer et maintenir des solutions complètes pour des applications personnalisées à l'aide de C\#, .NET Framework/.NET Core et ASP.NET MVC.
* Implémentation frontale : créer des interfaces web réactives et conviviales à l'aide de technologies frontales telles que HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery et des frameworks modernes comme React.
* Développement back\-end et API : développer la logique côté serveur, les règles métier et créer/utiliser des API RESTful et des services web pour une intégration transparente entre les systèmes.
* Gestion de bases de données : concevoir des schémas de bases de données et écrire des procédures stockées efficaces.
* Collaboration et documentation : collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles, y compris des analystes commerciaux, afin de traduire les exigences commerciales en spécifications techniques et de créer une documentation technique.
* Tests et débogage : effectuer des tests unitaires, d'intégration et système, et résoudre/déboguer les problèmes afin de garantir la stabilité et les performances du système.
* Contrôle de version et DevOps : utiliser des systèmes de contrôle de version tels que Gitlab et participer aux pipelines CI/CD.
* Assistance : fournir une assistance et une maintenance continues pour les applications existantes, y compris la correction de bogues et l'optimisation des performances.
* Mises à jour et visibilité : assister aux réunions d'équipe et d'examen des projets et fournir les mises à jour appropriées. Le travail et le code doivent être documentés conformément aux derniers processus définis.


**Compétences requises :**


**Programmation :**


* Net (formulaires Web et MVC)
* C\#
* .NET
* Visual Basic.NET (atout)
* Langage hypertexte 5 (HTML5\)
* JavaScript
* Feuilles de style en cascade (CSS)
* Langage de requête structuré (SQL)
* Excel VBA (atout)
* Diagrammes UML (atout)


**Système :**


* Windows Server (versions prises en charge), (services Internet, gestion du secteur Active Directory) (atout)
* Systèmes MES, ERP, qualité et PLM


**Qualifications requises :**


* Bilingue, à l'oral et à l'écrit (français/anglais) (Contact avec les clients ainsi que le personnel du siège social en Ontario)

jobs.title: IT Business Analyst - Digital Integrations
jobs.description:
Imperial Brady is a leading distributor of foodservice packaging, facilities maintenance supplies, printing papers, and equipment across North America. With a strong and growing presence in Canada, we proudly serve Canadian businesses and communities with the highest standards of quality, reliability, and service.
  
  

A Deep Canadian Legacy
  
Imperial Brady Canada is deeply rooted in the country, with over 135 years of Canadian history and a workforce of 1,500 Canadian employees. Our operations span 35 locations from coast to coast, including Saint John, Newfoundland and Vancouver, British Columbia—ensuring efficient service and local support nationwide. We are incorporated in Canada, and our 100% Canadian leadership team ensures that decisions for Canada are made in Canada.
  
  

Trusted by Canadian Businesses
  
We are a key distributor partner to many Canadian manufacturers, supporting long\-standing relationships and ensuring the timely availability of high\-quality products. Our Canadian customer service team understands the unique needs of Canadian businesses and delivers tailored solutions with a local touch.
  
  

Imperial Brady Canada, leading national distributor, has a job open in Saint\-Laurent, QC. The IT Business Analyst \- Digital Integrations serves as a critical link between business stakeholders, customers, vendors, and technical teams to drive successful digital transformation and integration initiatives. This role is responsible for supporting and delivering customer and vendor integration projects, documenting business processes and system requirements, managing production support activities, developing operational reporting and performance metrics, and identifying opportunities for process improvements and future technology enhancements.
  
The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis skills with technical aptitude, enabling them to translate business needs into scalable digital solutions while ensuring operational stability and continuous improvement.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

Digital Integration Management
  
* Lead and support digital integration projects involving customers, vendors, third\-party partners, and internal systems.
* Gather, analyze, and document business, technical, and data requirements for integrations.
* Facilitate communication between business stakeholders, trading partners, vendors, and development teams.
* Support implementation of APIs, EDI transactions, web services, data exchanges, and other digital connectivity solutions.
* Coordinate project timelines, testing activities, issue resolution, and go\-live readiness.
* Monitor integration performance and proactively address issues impacting business operations.
* Manage onboarding of new digital customers and vendors through established integration processes.
* Collaborate with internal and external partners to improve data accuracy, efficiency, and automation.


Business Analysis \& Requirements Management
  
* Elicit, analyze, validate, and document business requirements for system enhancements, integrations, and operational initiatives.
* Create functional specifications, business requirements documents (BRDs), process flows, use cases, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, and discovery sessions to identify business needs.
* Translate complex business requirements into actionable technical requirements for development teams.
* Ensure solutions align with business objectives and enterprise technology standards.
* Support change management and user adoption initiatives related to new technology implementations.


Process Documentation \& Optimization
  
* Develop and maintain comprehensive process documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), workflows, and system documentation.
* Analyze existing business processes and identify opportunities for increased automation and efficiency.
* Create current\-state and future\-state process maps.
* Define, document, and standardize operational procedures across teams and departments.
* Ensure documentation remains accurate and current following system changes or process updates.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives that reduce manual effort and enhance operational effectiveness.


Reporting \& Team Metrics
  
* Design, develop, and maintain operational reports, dashboards, and performance metrics.
* Analyze business and operational data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) for integrations, production support, project delivery, and team effectiveness.
* Prepare recurring management reports and executive summaries.
* Monitor integration volumes, processing performance, service levels, and exception management metrics.
* Support data\-driven decision making across business and IT teams.


Production Support \& System Maintenance
  
* Serve as a primary business resource supporting production applications and integration platforms.
* Investigate and troubleshoot production incidents, data exceptions, and system issues.
* Coordinate issue resolution across business teams, vendors, and technical support organizations.
* Monitor system health and integration processing to ensure operational stability.
* Support release management, application upgrades, system patches, and maintenance activities.
* Document root cause analyses and corrective action plans.
* Ensure production support activities are tracked, communicated, and resolved according to service expectations.


Enhancement Identification \& Strategic Planning
  
* Evaluate enhancement requests and recommend solutions based on business value and operational impact.
* Partner with stakeholders to prioritize future digital initiatives.
* Develop business cases supporting system improvements and automation opportunities.
* Identify technology gaps and recommend solutions that improve scalability, customer experience, and operational efficiency.

**Work at CBC/Radio\-Canada**


At CBC/Radio\-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance.
  

  

Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever\-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.


**Unposting Date:**

2026\-09\-29 11:59 PM
**Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next\-generation public service media organization.**


Technology \& Infrastructure (T\&I) is the backbone and the future\-forward arm of CBC/Radio\-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.


A place with purpose. CBC/Radio\-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.


**This is a hybrid role with a mix of in\-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.**


**Your Role**

  

  

CBC/Radio\-Canada is seeking a Lead Analyst, Data Protection Specialist, to design, lead and evolve the Corporation’s data security program.


In this role, you will provide technical and operational leadership to safeguard sensitive data and personal information throughout the data life cycle (collection, processing, storage, transmission, archiving and destruction). You will collaborate closely with Legal Services, privacy officers, enterprise architects and IT Operations to align data security with regulatory requirements and industry standards.


**This position can be based in Montreal or Toronto.**


**What’s in It for You**


Challenges. We spend our days solving problems of all kinds. Media files are highly nuanced and incredibly complicated; updating, installing and supporting technologies that are organization\-wide and that impact broadcasting content is a time\-sensitive, complex technical feat. And that’s just the beginning. You’ll be working with leading\-edge data management, cloud, IP broadcasting, AI, security and reliability technologies.


**As Lead Analyst, you will:**


* Define data security strategy: Develop and refine the road map for the Corporation’s data protection program.
* Implement data classification: Establish and deploy data classification policies and frameworks.
* Administer data protection technologies: Select, deploy and optimize data loss prevention (DLP) tools.
* Protect cloud and hybrid environments: Design security controls tailored to cloud\-hosted data and hybrid architectures.
* Partner on compliance and policy frameworks: Work closely with the policy, compliance and legal affairs lead to align security controls with statutory requirements.
* Manage the data security risk register: Document, maintain and map risks related to confidentiality, potential data breaches and approved exceptions.
* Adjudicate and govern exception requests: Evaluate, document and follow up on exception requests when standard security controls cannot be immediately applied, ensuring appropriate compensating controls are established.
* Lead data breach response: Actively participate in investigations of suspected or confirmed data breaches in co\-ordination with the Information Security, Legal Services and Incident Response teams.
* Develop metrics and dashboards: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) to monitor program effectiveness.
* Assess program maturity: Plan and conduct periodic evaluations, performance reviews and audits of data protection controls to identify gaps, measure maturity progress and formulate recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Maintain industry expertise: Stay current on information security best practices and industry trends.

**What You Bring**


* University degree in computer science, IT or information security.
* Minimum five years’ experience in data protection, privacy security, DLP or data governance, including at least three years in an information security role.
* Proven track record of implementing and evaluating technical data protection programs within large, complex organizations.
* Deep technical expertise in data protection, including cryptography (encryption at rest and in transit, PKI), DLP tools (network, endpoint, cloud), CASB technologies and SQL/NoSQL databases.
* Extensive knowledge of security technology and risk assessment methodologies, policies and processes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts for non\-technical decision\-makers (e.g., governance committees, business units, legal teams).
* Excellent analytical, evaluative and problem\-solving abilities.
* Experience with compliance programs as well as their technical and security requirements.
* Technical expertise across key domains:
	+ Standards and Frameworks: Strong command of industry standards such as ISO/IEC 27001, 2700

Portage CyberTech opère à l'intersection de la confiance numérique, de l'identité, de la vie privée et de la sécurité. **Aperçu du rôle (Le « pourquoi » du rôle)**

Portage CyberTech est à la recherche d’un(e) Analyste d’affaires technique (Technical Business Analyst) afin de joindre son équipe d’ingénierie et contribuer à la livraison de solutions logicielles modernes.

  

  

En collaboration avec les équipes Produit, Architecture et Développement, vous transformerez les besoins d’affaires en exigences techniques claires, en facilitant la compréhension des solutions, la préparation du backlog et la réussite des initiatives.

  

  

Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l’analyse des besoins, la documentation des solutions, l’identification des dépendances et l’amélioration continue des pratiques de livraison. Vous utiliserez également des outils d’intelligence artificielle afin d’accroître votre efficacité dans l’analyse, la documentation et la collaboration avec les équipes.

**Connaissances techniques et de domaine**

**Atout / Préférence**

**HIRING: Role: Cloud Governance Business Analyst**


**Location: Montreal, Canada**


**Work Arrangement:** **100% Onsite 5 Days/Week**


**Working Hours:** **8:00 AM 5:00 PM**


We are looking for a strong **Business Analyst** with experience in **Cloud Governance, Governance Process Definition, Process Modelling, Requirements Analysis, and Documentation** to support a **Cloud First Program**.


The Cloud First Business Analyst will serve as the **Governance Analyst and Documentation Lead**, working under the direction of the Program Management Team and Program Technical Lead.


TOP 3 REQUIRED SKILLS


**Business Analysis**


**Designing Governance Processes \& Definitions**


**Basic Azure Cloud Knowledge**


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


The Cloud First Business Analyst serves as the governance analyst and documentation lead for the Cloud First Program. Working under the direction of the Program Management Team and Program Technical Lead, the role documents governance entities defines inputs and outputs, models governance processes, and develops the artefacts required to operationalize the Cloud First governance framework.


Purpose of the Role


The role identifies information requirements, analyses governance needs, documents agreed outcomes, develops governance artefacts, and models end\-to\-end processes. Stakeholder engagement, workshop coordination, meeting management, communications, approval follow\-up, and final governance decisions remain with the Program Management Team and Program Technical Lead.


Key Responsibilities


1\. Governance Operating Model


Support the Program Management Team and Program Technical Lead in finalizing the definition of all Cloud First governance entities.


Document the purpose, scope, responsibilities, authority, decision rights, membership, and cadence of each governance entity.


Maintain the governance catalogue and operating model.


2\. Inputs and Outputs Definition


Define and document the inputs required by each governance entity.


Define outputs, decisions, approvals, actions, and artefacts produced by each governance entity.


Produce governance interaction models that show information flows between governance bodies.


3\. Governance Process Definition


Work with the Program Technical Lead to define the processes executed within each governance entity.


Document process objectives, triggers, activities, approvals, decision points, and outcomes.


Apply consistent documentation standards across the programme.


4\. Process Modelling and Repository Management


Develop clear process maps and flowcharts for governance processes.


Document workflow dependencies, approvals, escalations, and hand\-offs.


Maintain the governance process repository and supporting artefacts.


Responsibility Boundaries


The Business Analyst supports analysis and documentation, but is not accountable for:


Arranging workshops or meetings


Managing stakeholder communications


Scheduling sessions or maintaining calendars


Chasing stakeholders for feedback


Securing approvals


Owning governance decisions


These activities remain the responsibility of the Cloud First Program Management Team, with support and direction from the Program Technical Lead.


Required Skills and Competencies


Strong business analysis, requirements analysis, and structured documentation skills.


Experience documenting governance operating models, decision rights, RACI matrices, and escalation frameworks.


Proficiency in process mapping, workflow analysis, and modelling dependencies, approvals, and hand\-offs.


Ability to translate complex governance discussions into clear, consistent, and usable artefacts.


Strong written communication, attention to detail, version control, and repository management.


Ability to collaborate effectively with programme management, technical leads, and governance stakeholders.


Preferred Experience and Tools


Experience supporting cloud transformation, cloud adoption, technology governance, or enterprise change programmes.


Working knowledge of common process\-modelling methods and tools such as Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, or equivalent.


Experience with Microsoft 365 collaboration and documentation tools, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.


Understanding of governance controls, approval workflows, decision logs, and document lifecycle management.


Education and Experience


Bachelor's degree in business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.


Business analysis or process\-modelling certification is advantageous.


Relevant experience level to be aligned with the organization's role\-grading and project requirements.


Success Measures


Governance artefacts are complete, accurate, consistent, traceable, and ready for review and approval.


Process models clearly show triggers, activities, decision points, approvals, escalations, dependencies, and outcomes.


Governance repositories remain current, controlled, and easy for stakeholders to navigate.


Deliverables are completed in line with agreed programme priorities and documentation standards

jobs.description:
Medisca est une entreprise mondiale qui s’appuie sur des partenariats solides pour servir les professionnels de la santé dans diverses disciplines liées au bien\-être. En proposant des solutions complètes et essentielles, y compris des ingrédients et des services pharmaceutiques, la fabrication de technologies de mélange, des tests analytiques et la formation, **Medisca comble les lacunes en matière de soins de santé** grâce à un engagement inébranlable en faveur de la précision, de l’innovation et de l’impact sociétal.


**L’analyste d’affaires** fera le pont entre les besoins d’affaires et les systèmes d’entreprise essentiels de Medisca — notamment les plateformes CRM et ERP — au sein d’une organisation réglementée et multi\-entités. Ce rôle consiste à diriger la collecte des exigences, la cartographie des processus et la conception de solutions pour les projets de mise en œuvre, d’amélioration et d’intégration de systèmes, en collaboration étroite avec les TI, les opérations et les parties prenantes d’affaires, afin de s’assurer que nos plateformes répondent à de véritables besoins d’affaires plutôt que de simplement automatiser les inefficacités existantes.


**L'opportunité**


**Responsabilités et fonctions :**


* Diriger les séances de collecte et d’élicitation des exigences avec les parties prenantes des ventes, des opérations, des finances, de l’entrepôt et du service à la clientèle pour les initiatives CRM et ERP
* Documenter les processus d’affaires actuels et futurs, incluant les cartes de processus, les diagrammes de flux de travail et les analyses d’écarts
* Traduire les exigences d’affaires en spécifications fonctionnelles exploitables par les équipes de développement et de configuration
* Collaborer avec les équipes CRM et ERP afin de définir la portée des améliorations, des intégrations et des efforts de migration de données
* Soutenir les projets de mise en œuvre de systèmes de bout en bout : découverte, conception, planification et exécution des tests d’acceptation utilisateur (UAT), formation et stabilisation post\-lancement
* Identifier et documenter les points d’intégration et les flux de données entre le CRM, l’ERP et les systèmes adjacents
* Faciliter les décisions de conception entre les priorités concurrentes des parties prenantes et documenter clairement les compromis et leur justification
* Assurer la responsabilité de la planification des UAT : conception des cas de test, triage des anomalies et approbation des parties prenantes
* Soutenir la gestion du changement ainsi que la formation et la documentation des utilisateurs finaux pour les nouveaux processus et changements de systèmes
* Maintenir la documentation des processus d’affaires et la traçabilité des exigences à travers les projets
* Contribuer à la gouvernance de projet : rapports d’état, suivi des risques et enjeux, et communication avec les parties prenantes

* Baccalauréat, ou expérience équivalente, en administration des affaires, systèmes d’information ou domaine connexe

Une expérience dans une industrie réglementée, dans des déploiements multi\-entités, avec une méthodologie de migration de données, ou une certification en analyse d’affaires (p. ex. CBAP, CCBA) constitue un atout
* Maîtrise de la suite Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, Teams, Excel) exigée; expérience avec des plateformes CRM/ERP un atout
* Souci du détail et sens des responsabilités; compétences avérées en prise de décision et en résolution de problèmes; capacité à travailler de manière autonome dans des initiatives transversales et ambiguës; orientation vers les solutions, avec la capacité de remettre en question, de façon constructive, une solution demandée qui ne répond pas au besoin d’affaires sous\-jacent

Nous investissons du temps et des ressources pour nous assurer que Medisca est à la hauteur des personnes que nous embauchons.

At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak\-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. Working at Bombardier means operating at the highest level. Every day, you are part of a team that delivers superior experiences and products, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in our industry and beyond. Ready to build your career? We want to hear from you.
At the heart of Pomerleau’s HR strategy, the HR Data Analyst will play a key role in structuring, maintaining, and leveraging HR data to support advanced use cases such as predictive analytics, intelligent automation, and AI\-driven initiatives. The HR Data Analyst will work closely with HR, IT/AI, and Data teams. This role combines expertise in HR data, data modeling, and an understanding of AI and business intelligence applications, with a strong focus on delivering business value.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  

  

  

  

* HR Data Transformation

•Map, document, and structure HR data sources, including SAP SuccessFactors (Employee Central, Compensation, Performance, Succession), •Cornerstone (LMS), Avature CRM (Recruitment), and other internal systems.
  

* Participate in the transformation of HR data with IT teams toward standardized, AI\-ready data models.
* Identify and address data quality issues (completeness, consistency, duplication) through regular audits.
* Define and maintain data models designed for analytics and AI use cases.
* HR Analytics and Business Intelligence
* Develop and enhance Power BI dashboards.
* Calculate and validate key HR KPIs, including headcount, turnover rates (voluntary, involuntary, rolling 12\-month trends, etc.), time\-based variations, predictive analytics, and more.
* Optimize dashboard readability and visualization impact for executive audiences.
* Support for AI Initiatives
* Prepare and structure data for AI use cases (e.g., employee attrition prediction, workforce segmentation).
* Collaborate with Data and IT teams to integrate HR data into AI environments.
* Contribute to the definition of relevant features and variables for AI models.
* Ensure data traceability and governance for datasets used in advanced analytical and AI models.
* Governance and Best Practices
* Participate in establishing data standards (naming conventions, KPI definitions, data dictionaries).
* Document data transformations and data flows.
* Contribute to the implementation of AI governance processes, including data traceability and audit compliance requirements.
* Stay informed on emerging HR technology and AI trends.

  

QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS
  

  

Education \& Experience
  

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in a Data Analyst role, ideally within an HR environment.
* Experience with HR systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Avature, or similar platforms is a strong asset.
* Experience in transformation initiatives involving data, HRIS, or AI is highly desirable.
* Experience with APIs or data integration is considered an asset.
* Knowledge of the construction industry or a multi\-site environment is an asset.
* Technical Skills
* Strong expertise in data modeling (schemas, normalization, analytical logic).
* Experience with Power BI, including DAX, data modeling, and visualizations.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel (Power Query is an asset).
* Familiarity with modern data environments such as Azure, Microsoft Fabric, and SQL.
* Understanding of artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts (feature engineering, datasets, data pipelines), without necessarily being a data science specialist.

Excellent command of both French and English, written and spoken.

* Strong analytical mindset and exceptional attention to detail in complex data environments.
* Ability to translate technical concepts into clear and understandable insights for non\-technical audiences.
* Self\-driven, proactive, and solution\-oriented.
* Strong collaboration skills and ability to work in a matrix environment with IT, Finance, and HR Operations teams.

  

WHAT POMERLEAU OFFERS

* Hybrid work model for corporate roles

jobs.description:
**YesWeHack – Hack the Good Way, Save the World (One Bug at a Time)**


At **YesWeHack**, we’re not just another cyber company, we’re a full\-blown movement. Our mission? **Stop cyber attacks in their tracks** with the power of our global Ethical Hackers Network (yep, that’s **135,000\+ badass hackers** and counting ).


Born in 2015 with a spark of rebellion and a whole lot of passion, we’ve grown into the **\#1 Bug Bounty platform in the EU**. From **Paris to Singapore**, we’re helping companies protect their digital stuff by unleashing the skills of real\-world hackers for good.


We’re flipping traditional cybersecurity on its head, using **Bug Bounty programs** to help organizations secure their exposed assets *fast*, *agile*, and with way more style than your average pentest report.


 Ethical Hackers.  

 Real\-World Impact.  

 No suits, just skills.

**Job description**
-------------------

**Security Analyst (Fluent French) – Join Our Hacktastic Team in Montréal!**


Hey there, curious minds and cyber guardians!  

YesWeHack is growing in North America, and we’re looking for a passionate **Security Analyst** to join our mission in **Montréal**. You'll be joining a tight\-knit crew of two (soon to be three!) who live and breathe security, love collaboration, and never back down from a good challenge.


This isn’t your average job ad, because we’re not your average team.


You may have to **work partially on weekends** as we have a follow the Sun strategy with team members worldwide (but your will recup your hours **during the week** too!)


 What You’ll Be Up To:


You’ll dive headfirst into the heart of our bug bounty platform, working hand\-in\-hand with our global community of ethical hackers. You'll assess and qualify vulnerability reports, help clients understand risks and solutions, and even build tools to make the hacker experience even more awesome.

**Your missions (should you choose to accept):**


* Reproduce \& document PoCs (Proof of Concepts) like a cyber Sherlock
* Assess the severity of vulnerabilities (using context, not just checklists)
* Chat with clients and help translate complex risks into human language
* Be the bridge between our ethical hackers and our clients
* Keep the vulnerability workflow running smoothly and efficiently


 Your Superpowers:

* Solid grasp of **security basics** (hello OWASP Top 10 )
* You wield **CVSS scoring** like a pro
* You’re fluent in **Burp Suite** and other security tools
* You’re fluent in **French \& English** (parce qu’on est à Montréal, bien sûr )

**Even better if you also bring:**


Python dev skills* Contributions to Open Source projects
* CTF or platform experience (TryHackMe, HackTheBox, Rootme, etc.)
* A nose for the latest CVEs, exploits, and cyber trends

Offensive Security Web Expertise (OSWE)
**Profile**
-----------


 Who You Are:


You're **naturally curious**, a **lifelong learner**, and love to dig into how systems tick (and how they can break ).  

You’ve probably spent a few nights falling down rabbit holes on a Bug Bounty platform, reading CVE writeups, or trying to exploit a CTF challenge “just one more time” at 2 a.m.


You’re **team\-oriented**, friendly, and love sharing your knowledge as much as learning from others. You respect the craft, and you bring that energy to your team.


 Why Join YesWeHack?


We’re a group of passionate people who love what we do, and it shows. You’ll get to work on meaningful projects, collaborate with a global hacker community, and make the internet a safer place while having a great time doing it.


✅ Friendly, fun, tech\-savvy team  

✅ Real impact and ownership  

✅ Work\-life balance
  

✅ Opportunities to grow in a fast\-moving, global company


**We can't wait to meet you!**


If this sounds like your kind of gig, drop us your CV or reach out to say hi. Even if you’re not 100% sure you check every box, apply anyway. We care more about your mindset and passion than perfect credentials.


 Let’s hack the Planet together!!

* Develop remediation plans: Recommend targeted corrective measures — such as patch management, system reconfigurations, temporary workarounds or WAF/firewall rules — for internal teams.

jobs.description:
MANNARINO Systems \& Software Inc. is a leader in providing safety\-critical systems, software, hardware and certification engineering services to the aerospace, defense, space, simulation \& power generation industries.


Our customer base is very large, covering traditional aerospace companies as well as new and exciting markets, including electric propulsion, Urban Air Mobility, Unmanned Aerial Vehicle and autonomous flight.


The MANNARINO culture is focused on high quality, hard work, professionalism and teamwork within a highly respectful, motivating atmosphere geared towards long\-term business growth.


As a member of our team, you will benefit from:

* a comprehensive group insurance and RRSP plan
* a flextime policy with paid overtime
* discretionary bonuses
* a fitness reimbursement program
* other office perks such as catered weekly lunches and free hot beverages (espresso, coffee, hot chocolate and tea)
* regular company outings

**Career Opportunity and Primary Roles / Responsibilities**


We are seeking an **Applied AI Engineer** to help implement secure, reliable AI\-assisted workflows for engineering and business activities. The successful candidate will report to the person leading the company's applied AI implementation program and will collaborate with engineering, IT and business stakeholders.


The role focuses on delivering practical AI\-enabled software solutions using commercial and open\-weight AI models. It does not involve foundation model research or developing new LLM architectures.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Work with IT to deploy and operate open\-weight LLMs on internal GPU infrastructure, including model serving, quantization, performance optimization and application reliability
* Build and maintain retrieval systems over company documentation and codebases, including ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search and reranking
* Package and deploy AI applications using sound software engineering and containerization practices
* Integrate AI\-enabled tools with internal systems, including Atlassian products, requirements\-management and configuration\-management platforms, using MCP and standard APIs
* Develop AI\-assisted workflows supporting engineering and business activities, such as drafting engineering artifacts, triaging problem reports, automating reports and performing business development research
* Implement prompt and model configuration, context management, structured outputs, validation rules, logging, error handling and access controls
* Design internal user interfaces that support practical day\-to\-day usage
* Implement provenance logging and traceability mechanisms for AI\-generated outputs
* Build evaluation frameworks and automated testing for accuracy, groundedness, consistency, safety, latency and regression detection
* Identify weaknesses in AI workflows and implement continuous improvements

**Required Competencies**

* Diploma or degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* Strong proficiency in Python and experience developing maintainable applications, services or automation tools
* Experience with Linux, Docker and Git
* Experience working with APIs and integrating data across systems
* Hands\-on experience developing LLM\-enabled applications using commercial, local or open\-weight models
* Experience building AI\-assisted workflows that combine model outputs with contextual or retrieved information
* Ability to evaluate AI outputs, identify inaccuracies or ungrounded responses and improve reliability through testing and validation
* Demonstrated experience building and maintaining software solutions beyond tutorials or proof\-of\-concept exercises
* Strong attention to detail, documentation and traceability

**Asset Qualifications**

* Experience with local or open\-weight models such as vLLM, Ollama or llama.cpp
* Knowledge of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), embedding models, vector databases and rerankers
* Experience with agent frameworks, tool calling or Model Context Protocol (MCP)
* Familiarity with knowledge graphs or GraphRAG
* Experience developing internal web applications and user interfaces
* Knowledge of automated testing, observability and secure application development
* Experience handling public, proprietary, confidential and controlled information appropriately

**Miscellaneous Requirements**

* Work can be done remotely.
* For employees based in Montreal, the work model is hybrid (at least one day at the office).
* The position may require occasional travel within North America.
* This position is open only to Canadian citizens and permanent residents currently residing in Canada.

**Why this Role is Worth Your Time**

* **Real hardware.** You will work with dedicated high\-memory GPU infrastructure, not only a metered API key. Running models on hardware the organization controls \- and dealing with what that actually involves \- is a valuable skill that many engineers do not get to develop
* **Scope.** Small team, broad remit and direct access to the people making decisions. What you build is intended for real use, and feedback will be direct
* **A hard domain.** Safety\-critical aerospace imposes constraints most AI work never encounters: traceability, reproducibility and evidence that may need to stand up to scrutiny years later. Learning to build AI systems within those constraints is genuinely differentiating
* **An opportunity to help shape the direction.** The architecture and implementation approach are still being developed

**How to Apply**


Send your CV and a short note \- a few paragraphs is plenty \- telling us about **something you built and ran yourself**: what it did, what broke and what you would do differently. We are more interested in that than in a list of technologies.


If you have a repository, demo or anything else we can review, include it. Please do not share confid

*When applicable, Bombardier promotes flexible and hybrid work policies.*

#### **Why join us?**

  

At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak\-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. We have been successful in setting the highest standards by putting our people at the heart of it all, and defining excellence, together.

  

Working at Bombardier means operating at the highest level. Every day, you are part of a team that delivers superior experiences and products, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in our industry and beyond. By prioritizing employee growth and development, we empower everyone to reach their full potential on their own terms, because the best work happens when you are free to be yourself and share your unique expertise.

#### **Bombardier’s Benefits Program**

  

With our employees’ well\-being top of mind, we offer a comprehensive and competitive Benefits Program, which includes the following:

* Insurance plans *(Dental, medical, life insurance, disability, and more)*
* Competitive base salary
* Retirement savings plan
* Employee Assistance Program
* Tele Health Program

**Overview**
------------


As part of our Digital \& Artificial Intelligence Department, you’ll work in an environment that encourages creativity and rewards excellence. You will bring AI\-enabled applications to life by transforming business needs and UI/UX concepts into intuitive, responsive, and visually compelling digital experiences. With expertise in modern front\-end frameworks and a strong product mindset, you will play a key role in making AI solutions easy to use, trustworthy, and impactful. While your primary focus will be front\-end development and user experience, an understanding of back\-end systems, APIs, and AI services is an important asset.

### **What are your contributions to the team?**

* Design and implement dynamic, responsive user interfaces using React, Angular, Blazor, or similar modern front\-end frameworks.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, business stakeholders, and product owners to translate concepts, wireframes, and user journeys into functional application code.
* Build front\-end experiences for AI\-enabled applications, including copilots, chat interfaces, knowledge search, workflow tools, and human\-in\-the\-loop review screens.
* Ensure seamless integration of front\-end components with back\-end systems, APIs, identity services, and approved AI services.
* Optimize applications for speed, scalability, accessibility, usability, and cross\-platform compatibility.
* Work closely with back\-end developers and AI engineers to deliver end\-to\-end functionality for enterprise applications.
* Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well\-documented code that follows internal standards and modern software development practices.
* Implement testing strategies to ensure reliability, accessibility, and performance of front\-end components.
* Stay updated on the latest front\-end technologies, design systems, AI product patterns, and user experience best practices.
* Proactively suggest improvements to user interfaces, user workflows, and AI interactions to increase adoption and business value.
* Contribute to the development of reusable UI components and design patterns for the AI \& Automation Center of Excellence.
### **How to thrive in this role?**

* You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Human\-Computer Interaction, Design, or a related field.
* You have 2 to 5 years of professional experience in front\-end or full\-stack development, with a strong portfolio showcasing responsive and interactive applications.
* You have hands\-on experience with React, Angular, Blazor, or similar frameworks in building modern web applications.
* You possess strong familiarity with UI/UX design principles and experience translating design prototypes into functional code.

**L’opportunité**
-----------------


Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) Développeur(se) Graphique pour se joindre à l’équipe Web Graphics de Unity. Notre équipe permet d’offrir de magnifiques graphiques 3D en temps réel dans les navigateurs Web grâce à WebGL et à WebGPU.


Vous travaillerez aux côtés d’autres Développeur(se)s Graphiques afin d’améliorer et de maintenir les technologies permettant d’afficher du contenu Unity sur la plateforme Web, en mettant l’accent sur l’exploration des possibilités de pointe qu’offre WebGPU! Ce poste vous permettra d’avoir une incidence directe sur l’un des plus importants marchés et l’une des plus importantes plateformes, le Web, et de collaborer avec des partenaires majeurs dans le domaine des plateformes et des processeurs graphiques.


La personne idéale possède une connaissance approfondie des graphismes et se passionne pour le développement de fonctionnalités destinées à un vaste éventail d’utilisateur(rice)s.

**Ce que vous ferez**
---------------------

* Développer de nouvelles fonctionnalités graphiques qui tirent parti des plateformes de nos partenaires.
* Contribuer au maintien des fonctionnalités graphiques existantes et améliorer leur performance, leur testabilité et leur stabilité.
* Participer à la planification et aux discussions techniques avec nos partenaires dans le domaine des plateformes et des processeurs graphiques.
* Prendre part aux examens de conception technique et aux revues de code, et créer des tests automatisés pour les nouvelles fonctionnalités.

**Ce que nous recherchons**
---------------------------

* Posséder une solide compréhension de la programmation de graphismes 3D en temps réel ainsi qu’une bonne connaissance de l’architecture moderne des processeurs graphiques.
* Maîtriser la programmation en C\+\+, en C\# et en JavaScript.
* Avoir de l’expérience avec une interface de programmation graphique comme WebGL, WebGPU, Direct3D ou Vulkan.
* Faire preuve d’une attitude proactive axée sur les solutions et d’un vif intérêt pour le rendu sur le Web.
* Être en mesure de diagnostiquer les bogues et les problèmes de performance.

 **Vous pourriez aussi avoir**

* Posséder de l’expérience en développement multiplateforme, particulièrement pour le Web, les appareils mobiles, la XR et les consoles.
* Avoir une connaissance pratique d’autres interfaces de programmation de plateformes, comme WebAssembly, Emscripten, Dawn/Tint, SPIR\-V et DXC.
* Posséder une expérience pratique avec Unity.


\-

We are looking for a Graphics Developer to join the Web Graphics team here at Unity. We enable beautiful realtime 3D graphics in web browsers via WebGL and WebGPU.

This role allows you to have a direct impact on one of the biggest markets and platforms, the web, and includes collaboration with major platform and GPU partners.

  

Our ideal candidate will have a deep knowledge of graphics and a passion for developing features that will be used by a broad range of users.

* Develop new graphics features that leverage our partners' platforms.
* Help maintain existing graphics functionality and improve performance, testability and stability.
* Participate in planning and technical discussions with our platform and GPU partners.
* Engage in technical design reviews, code reviews and build automated tests for new features.

 **What we're looking for**

* Solid understanding of real\-time 3D graphics programming with a good knowledge of modern GPU architecture.
* Strong C\+\+, C\#, and Javascript programming skills.
* Experience with a graphics API such as WebGL, WebGPU, Direct3D, or Vulkan.
* Proactive, solution\-oriented mindset with a keen interest in rendering on the web.
* Ability to diagnose bugs and performance issues.

**You might also have**

* Experience of development for multiple platforms. Web, Mobile, XR and Console are especially of interest.
* Working knowledge of other platform APIs such as Web Assembly, Emscripten, Dawn/Tint, SPIR\-V, DXC.
* Hands\-on experience working with Unity.

jobs.title: Software Developer, SharePoint Backend
jobs.description:
**Software Developer, SharePoint Backend**

  


**Location:** Montreal, Canada / Hybrid


**Employment type:** Full\-time


**Company:** Montrium inc.

  


**Please note:** This is a hybrid Montreal\-based role. Candidates must either currently reside within commuting distance of Montreal or be able and willing to relocate prior to their start date.

  



Montrium is looking for a **Software Developer, SharePoint Backend** to help evolve the backend foundation of our Connect platform, which supports regulated life sciences teams around the world.



This is a hands\-on role for a developer who enjoys backend engineering, SharePoint platform work, integrations, and thoughtful modernization in a product environment where reliability, traceability, and quality matter.



What you’ll do


* Develop, maintain, and modernize backend components that interact with SharePoint services, configuration, data structures, APIs, SDKs, object models, web services, and integrations.
* Configure and extend SharePoint structures such as templates, lists, libraries, metadata, content types, views, permissions, workflows, and settings for regulated product capabilities.
* Develop ASPX\-based forms, application logic, and related components that capture, validate, and present data through SharePoint lists, libraries, workflows, metadata, and backend services.
* Turn product requirements and technical designs into reliable, maintainable, secure, and testable code while improving backend performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Troubleshoot customer\-facing and platform issues involving API behaviour, permissions, configuration, data access, workflow execution, backend services, and integrations.
* Contribute to code reviews, design discussions, release preparation, packaging, deployment artifacts, release notes, controlled promotion, documentation, knowledge sharing, and clear communication of risks, dependencies, trade\-offs, and progress.


What we’re looking for


* Five or more years of software development experience, including SharePoint applications or Microsoft platform development.
* Strong experience with C\#, .NET, and related application technologies, plus working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and web application patterns.
* Experience developing with SharePoint APIs, SDKs, object models, web services, or integration interfaces, and configuring SharePoint lists, libraries, content types, metadata, views, templates, permissions, workflows, and regulated content processes.
* Experience with SharePoint permissions, identity concepts, groups, inheritance, secure access patterns, packaging, deployment, controlled promotion, Git, CI/CD, code review, unit testing, automated functional testing, and controlled software delivery.
* Understanding of secure development practices and how security principles apply to platform\-based applications.
* A collaborative, curious, and adaptable working style, with strong communication, ownership, time management, comfort working through ambiguity, and the judgement to balance technical details with product, quality, and customer needs. College diploma, university degree, or equivalent practical experience is expected, and written and spoken fluency in English and French is essential; other languages are an asset.


Nice to have


* Experience with SharePoint Server, SharePoint Subscription Edition, hybrid SharePoint environments, or classic SharePoint customization and deployment models.
* Experience with legacy SharePoint technologies such as ASPX\-based forms, WCF/SOAP services, or XSLT, and maintaining or modernizing established platform\-based components.
* Experience troubleshooting production or customer\-facing SharePoint\-backed applications, including permissions, configuration, data access, workflow execution, and integration behaviour.
* Experience with SQL, data modelling, migrations, backend data troubleshooting, data\-driven application features, Azure services, PowerShell, monitoring tools, or DevOps practices.
* Experience in a SaaS, regulated, pharmaceutical, life sciences, or GxP environment; Microsoft Azure or developer certification, or willingness to pursue one.


Why join Montrium?


* Work on software that supports regulated life sciences research, compliant content processes, and meaningful customer outcomes.
* Join a collaborative engineering team that values practical design, shared ownership, sustainable delivery, thoughtful modernization, and visible contribution in a smaller\-company environment.
* Use modern productivity and AI\-assisted development tools, including GitHub Enterprise Copilot and Microsoft 365 AI capabilities, to support coding, documentation, collaboration, and engineering efficiency.
* Benefit from hybrid work flexibility, regular weekly presence at our office in the Old Port of Montreal, and temporary work\-from\-abroad flexibility for up to six weeks per year, subject to role expectations and collaboration needs.
* Access career development support, coaching, ongoing learning, an annual training stipend, healthcare benefits, paid time off starting at three weeks per year, and a workplace committed to respect, continuous growth, and equal opportunity.


About Montrium



Founded in 2005 and headquartered in Montreal, Montrium provides cloud\-based solutions for the life sciences industry. Our Connect platform helps organizations manage regulated content and processes across the research and development lifecycle.



Today, thousands of users across more than 35 countries rely on Connect to support compliant, traceable, and effective operations.



If you enjoy backend development, SharePoint platform work, thoughtful modernization, and building software that supports meaningful work in life sciences, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: IT Support Technician III
jobs.description:
CPP Clinics is a leading provider of medical aesthetics services, offering innovative treatments across multiple medspas under the CPP umbrella. We are dedicated to delivering exceptional patient experiences and outstanding results, utilizing advanced technologies and personalized care.

 **The Role**


We're hiring an **IT Support Technician III** in Montréal to act as the senior escalation point for our clinics across the United States. This is a hands\-on, queue\-driven role: you'll work tickets every day, resolving the problems our 1st and 2nd line technicians can't across Microsoft 365, endpoints, security tooling, telephony, and networking.


One day you might be untangling an Exchange Online mail\-flow issue, triaging an EDR alert, rebuilding a clinic's phone tree, and setting up a new site's network. You'll escalate infrastructure, security, and architecture work to our Senior IT Engineer.

**What you'll do**

* **Work the escalation queue**: This is the core of the job. You'll live in Zendesk: taking escalated tickets from our 1st and 2nd line technicians, driving them to resolution against SLA, and being the last stop before an issue reaches our Senior IT Engineer.
* **Microsoft 365 and Entra ID**: Exchange Online mail flow, SharePoint and OneDrive permissions, Teams, licensing, MFA and conditional access, and tenant\-to\-tenant migrations.
* **RMM and MDM**: Windows and macOS builds, patching, policy, application packaging, remote support, and agent health across the fleet. Printing, scanning and peripherals sit here too.
* **Security tooling** **(AV / EDR)**: Triage and action endpoint detection alerts, keep agent coverage complete across every device, support phishing simulation and security awareness campaign, and escalate genuine incidents promptly.
* **VoIP and telephony**: Cloud VoIP administration, IVR and call\-flow builds, ring groups, voicemail, number porting, handsets, and call routing across time zones.
* **Networking:** Diagnose connectivity, wireless, VLAN, VPN, and firewall issues at clinic sites; coordinate with ISPs and escalate hardware faults.
* **Clinic onboarding:** Once onboarded and have a full understanding of clinic structure you will help with clinic onboardings and standardization.
* **Clinical platform support (secondary)**: Day\-to\-day account, access, and workstation\-side support for our EMR and practice\-management systems (Zenoti, Nextech, PatientNow, Dr. Chrono, Meevo) and consultation\-room iPads and imaging hardware.
* **Documentation and mentoring:** Maintain SOPs and knowledge\-base articles in Zendesk, keep asset and licence records accurate, and coach the L1/L2 technicians so more issues are solved correctly the first time.

**Schedule:** Monday to Friday, 10:00 – 18:00 Eastern, aligned to our US clinics' business hours. We don't run weekend support, though the team occasionally helps out for urgent issues or planned cutovers.


You'll work to our published SLA: 60\-minute average first response and 3\-business\-day resolution on standard tickets; 15\-minute response and 4\-business\-hour restoration on P1 incidents. We care as much about tickets staying closed as about closing them quickly.

**What we're looking for**

* 5\+ years in IT support, including 2\+ years at a 3rd\-line or senior escalation level. This is a senior role
* Real depth in Microsoft 365 and Entra ID administration
* Strong Windows and macOS troubleshooting, with hands\-on RMM and MDM experience managing a fleet.
* Working knowledge of endpoint security tooling — AV / EDR alert triage, agent deployment and coverage.
* Experience administering a cloud VoIP platform, including building call flows or IVRs.
* Solid networking fundamentals: DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPN, firewall rules, Wi\-Fi.
* Comfortable working a ticket queue to SLA in a helpdesk platform such as Zendesk, and documenting as you go.
* Excellent communication — you can explain a technical problem to a non\-technical clinician with patience and clarity.
* Comfortable supporting users remotely across multiple sites and time zones, and prioritising against SLA.
* Legally entitled to work in Canada.

**Nice to** **have:** experience supporting users across multiple sites or at a managed service provider; Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace tenant migrations; familiarity with HIPAA or another data\-protection regime.

**Language:** Knowledge of English is required, as this role provides direct daily support — verbal and written — to clinic staff located exclusively in the United States, and our clinical, security, and vendor platforms operate in English. French is an asset but is not required for the duties of the role.

**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. **Aperçu de l’entreprise**

Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Connectez\-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez\-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

Motorola Solutions is the leading software developer and solution provider for Emergency Call Handling, the software that enables 911 centers to receive and process calls in Public Safety Answering Points across North America. The Emergency Call Handling solution team is one business sleeve of the Motorola Solutions Software Enterprise where innovation of workflow enhancements are being developed for call handling, incident management, responder dispatching and situational awareness.
  

  

Présentation du Département
  

Motorola Solutions est le leader dans le développement de logiciels et la fourniture de solutions pour la gestion des appels d'urgence. Ces logiciels permettent aux centres 911 de recevoir et de traiter les appels dans les centres de réception des appels de sécurité publique (Public Safety Answering Points) à travers l'Amérique du Nord. L'équipe de solutions pour la gestion des appels d'urgence constitue une branche clé de la division Software Enterprise de Motorola Solutions, où des innovations sont développées pour améliorer les flux de travail liés à la gestion des appels, à la gestion des incidents, au dispatch des intervenants, et à la surveillance situationnelle.
**Job Description**
-------------------

As a software developer, you will be joining a team developing a next generation 911 call handling solution that complies with industry standards and market demands, is capable of being deployed as a service or on\-premises and meets high availability requirements our users have come to expect of 911 services. The team will utilize development talent across multiple design centers using Agile scrum methodology.

Dans des marchés en rapide évolution, les clients à travers le monde font confiance à Thales. Thales est une entreprise où les personnes les plus brillantes du monde entier se regroupent pour mettre en commun leurs idées et ainsi s'inspirer mutuellement. Dans tous les secteurs où œuvre Thales, notamment l’aérospatiale, le transport, la défense, la sécurité et l'espace, nos équipes d’architectes conçoivent des solutions innovantes qui rendent demain possible dès aujourd’hui.
Au sein du groupe, Thales Digital Solutions (TDS) est un pôle d’innovation technologique supportant tous les secteurs d’activités autant sur le marché local canadien qu’à l'international. Rejoignez\-nous afin de contribuer au développement de solutions pour nos missions critiques. Nos projets de pointe variés utilisent nos expertises en Intelligence Artificielle, Facteurs Humains, Systèmes autonomes collaboratifs, Optimisation, Gestion de la connaissance, Cybersécurité et Design.
In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

Join us to contribute to the development of mission critical solutions. Our various cutting\-edge projects use our expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Human Factors, Collaborative Autonomous Systems, Optimization, Knowledge Management, Cybersecurity and Design.**Full Stack Developer – Agentic AI**

***Ville de Québec, QC (Hybride) Temps plein***

**Résumé du poste**

Notre équipe réalise des travaux de recherche et développement (R\&D) pour répondre aux besoins du département de la Défense nationale (DND) et des Forces armées canadiennes (CAF). Les projets portent sur des solutions numériques innovantes combinant développement logiciel, intégration de systèmes, infrastructure moderne et intelligence artificielle générative.


Dans le cadre de l'accélération de nos initiatives en intelligence artificielle, nous souhaitons développer une nouvelle génération d'applications basées sur l'Agentic AI. Ces solutions vont au\-delà des assistants conversationnels traditionnels en permettant à des agents intelligents d'analyser des données, de raisonner, de prendre des décisions, d'orchestrer des workflows complexes et d'interagir avec plusieurs systèmes d'entreprise de manière autonome et sécurisée.


Nous recherchons une personne Développeur Full Stack spécialisée en IA générative et en Agentic AI pour rejoindre notre équipe à Québec, spécialisée dans la gestion des connaissances. Nos projets impliquent la définition et le déploiement de chaînes de traitement automatisées pour rendre les données accessibles aux utilisateurs. Avec le soutien de nos scientifiques de données, l'équipe conçoit, entraîne et intègre des modèles d’intelligence artificielle, y compris l'IA générative (GenAI) basée sur des grands modèles de langue (LLM), afin d’améliorer l’analyse des données. Notre équipe utilise également des concepts d'IA et de machine learning (ML) pour accroître l’efficacité des analyses.

La personne titulaire du poste Développeur(se) Full Stack spécialisé(e) en IA générative et Agentic AI jouera un rôle clé dans la conception, le développement et la mise en production de plateformes et applications intelligentes intégrant des modèles de langage (LLM), des architectures multi\-agents, des moteurs RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation), des outils d'orchestration et des services cloud de nouvelle génération. Cette personne devra être autonome, curieuse et à l’aise dans un contexte de R\&D où les besoins évoluent rapidement. Cette personne travaillera avec les équipes d’architecture, de développement et les spécialistes en intelligence artificielle afin de transformer des concepts techniques en solutions concrètes, démontrables et évolutives.


Cette personne fait partie d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire. Un fort esprit d'équipe et la capacité de travailler en collaboration sont obligatoires. La personne idéale est donc en mesure de démontrer des compétences transversales qui facilitent le transfert du travail effectué à l'ensemble des parties prenantes concernées. Par conséquent, de bonnes capacités de communication sont requises.

* Analyze the business needs of the different departments and recommend appropriate technological solutions.
* Design, develop, test and maintain applications on the IBM i platform (AS/400\).
* Programming mainly in RPG III, RPG IV, RPGLE and SQL.
* Participate in the evolution and optimization of business systems.
* Perform functional and technical analyses of change requests.
* Develop and maintain interfaces between the various internal and external systems.
* Provide advanced level support to users.
* Diagnose and resolve application and performance issues.
* Perform unit, integrated and validation testing.
* Produce and maintain technical and functional documentation.
* Participate in continuous improvement projects.
* Collaborate with IT teams, business users and external partners.

* A DEC or bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field.

* A good knowledge of DB2 databases.
* Experience in business process analysis and writing functional and technical specifications.
* Experience in supporting and maintaining critical applications.


Advantages

* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
